name: mine-independent-inspect-inversion
description: Independent mutation that inverts the inspect parameter at the call site of clickProvince in referenceBattleGame.ts. This breaks both direct attack and Shift selection behaviors, demonstrating that the new MapHandlers activation metadata is required.
mutation: src/ui/referenceBattleGame.ts: change `activation?.inspect ?? false` to `!(activation?.inspect ?? false)` in the onProvince handler
